name: Nochnoj Incident
source: What happens to a person if he spends 1000 years in one cycle? No, this is not just another bloody story about a crazy pioneer, although there is blood in it too. This is a story about his quiet days, about his attempt to gather his humanity and not crumble into dust completely.
translation: 如果一个人度过1000年一个周期，会发生什么？不，这不仅仅是另一个关于疯狂拓荒者的血腥故事，尽管其中也有血腥。这是一个关于他平静日子的故事，关于他试图聚集自己的人性而不是完全崩溃的故事。
